name: OpenAI News
notes: Official OpenAI newsroom feed. May support claims about OpenAI products, models, research, safety, policy and company announcements. Vendor performance claims remain vendor claims and are not independent validation. Feed-only; do not fetch article pages.

name: Google DeepMind News
notes: Official Google DeepMind news feed. May support claims about DeepMind models, research, safety and company announcements. Benchmark and performance claims remain vendor claims. Feed-only; do not fetch article pages.

name: AWS Machine Learning Blog
notes: Official AWS AI and machine-learning blog. Contains product announcements, tutorials, customer stories and partner content. It is primary only for AWS announcements; customer outcomes and comparative claims require separate verification. Feed-only.

name: GitHub Changelog
notes: Official GitHub product changelog. Suitable for release, improvement and retirement dates. Contains substantial non-AI content, so no SourceItem may be promoted to editorial use until a later relevance filter is implemented. Feed-only.

name: Hugging Face Blog
notes: Mixed official and community-authored feed. Do not treat all entries as Hugging Face corporate claims. Until item-level publisher classification exists, entries are technical signals requiring author and organization verification. Feed-only.

name: OpenAI Python SDK Releases
notes: Release feed for the official openai/openai-python repository. Suitable for SDK version, release date and release-note evidence only. An SDK release must not be interpreted as an OpenAI model or product launch. Feed-only.
